full_judgment:
Mr. Bimalendu Bikash Roy Choudhury, J:- These two petitions are for leave to appeal from the same judgment and order dated 2 December 1998 of a Single Bench of the High Court Division in Civil Revision No. 4493 of 1995 whereby, in reversal of the appellate courts' decree, that of the trial court was restored decreeing the plaintiffs suit. 

 9. On perusal of the judgment of the High Court Division it appears that the learned Single Judge came to the conclusion that the judgment of the appellate court was not a proper judgment of reversal. In coming to this conclusion the said Court noticed that the trial court had considered. the material evidence in detail in coming to its finding of title and possession in favour of the plaintiffs, but the appellate court, without discussing the evidence, had abruptly reversed findings of fact arrived at by the trial court. We find no error of law in the view taken by the High Court Division.
